# Tank Mate Match

> A tank-mate checker for common freshwater aquarium animals. Every range is tied to a named source, and the result says why.

The canonical site is https://tankmatematch.com (apex, no www). Facts are written in the HTML of each species and tank-mate page, with the source named on the page. The checker itself runs in the browser. This file was generated from the species records on 2026-10-30.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://tankmatematch.com): Checker embedded on the home page, plus links to every species.
- [Tank mate checker](https://tankmatematch.com/checker): Compare two or more species. The selection is stored in the URL.
- [Species index](https://tankmatematch.com/species): The ten freshwater animals in this version.
- [How a verdict is reached](https://tankmatematch.com/methodology): Sources, disagreements, and the Compatible / Caution / Not compatible rules.
- [About](https://tankmatematch.com/about): What the site is for.
- [Privacy](https://tankmatematch.com/privacy): No accounts and no analytics in this version.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://tankmatematch.com/affiliate-disclosure): No affiliate links or ads in this version.
